title: Weak Hodge Theorem on Piecewise-Algebraic Spaces
summary: We prove a weak version of the classical Hodge theorem on piecewise-algebraic spaces, a class of spaces introduced by Kontsevich and Soibelman in [KS00]. Precisely, we first prove the Poincare lemma that computes singular cohomology as a variant of de Rham cohomology. Then, as a weak Hodge theorem, we naturally embed the singular cohomology into the space of harmonic forms, instead of establishing an isomorphism (which does not hold for those spaces).
